mentions.name: Locally hosted language learner app
mentions.description: Fully locally hosted language learner app that builds lessons based on a 4-year college curriculum using a local LLM, Qwen TTS, local speech-to-text, and ComfyUI image generation. It formulates themed lessons around interesting stories, generating dialogue, images, audio, quizzes, and pronunciation tests. Each lesson's progress is tracked and new lessons are generated daily to reinforce concepts and extend past lesson storylines, working like a choose-your-own-adventure book you learn while doing. Supports Spanish, French, German, Japanese, and Simplified Chinese, and runs on a 16GB RTX 4060 card.
